summary: A looser-to-enforce noise rule quiets one neighborhood, but its test is the busy season.
realLife: A city let police act on noise a reasonable person would find loud, rather than only noise over a fixed level. Neighbors in a nightlife district reported slightly less noise and called themselves cautiously optimistic. Officers explained to bars what was acceptable. The neighborhood group said the cool season might explain part of the calm and that summer would be the real test.
sources: WTVD ABC11 (Raleigh, North Carolina), 'Glenwood South neighbors, businesses cautiously optimistic as noise ordinance takes effect', date not shown on the page: https://abc11.com/post/raleigh-glenwood-south-noise-ordinance-acceptable-unacceptable/14385832/
